info.title: Component Repository API
info.description: REST API for managing CWL-based workflow components

post.description:
A fresh token for a still-valid one - the frontend's sliding session. It calls this
while the user is active, so a session only ends after a full token lifetime
(JWT_EXPIRES_IN) without any activity. An already expired token can't be refreshed.

schema.title: Response List Latest Components Components Latest Get

get.description:
Whether `name` is still free for a new lineage - of either kind.

`available` reflects the whole catalogue, since names are globally unique across tools
and workflows. `existing` is only filled in when the caller may actually see that
component - a name held by somebody else's draft still reads as taken, just without
details.

NOTE: must stay declared above GET /{component_id} - FastAPI matches routes in
declaration order, and "name-availability" would otherwise be parsed as a component id.

schema.title: Response Get Component Components  Component Id  Get

403.description: Not the creator of this component

409.description: Public workflows run this version - other users' ones, your own deprecated ones, or your own without unpublishParents

schema.title: Response Get Versions Components  Component Id  Versions Get

get.description:
The workflows running any version of this component - a tool, or a nested

get.description:

beforehand: the public workflows above it (other users' ones block either action), and

400.description: Command is missing a payload field it requires (e.g. UPDATE_DOMAIN without domains), or a workflow is not ready to publish

Package a GitHub repo without persisting it, so the user can review the generated
tool (and label its File ports) before POST /tools/package creates it.
Mirrors POST /tools/parse.

ComponentAncestorDto.title: ComponentAncestorDto
ComponentAncestorDto.description:
A public workflow running the component at some depth. Named after no status on
purpose - any public status may show up here, so `status` says which.

command.description: The specific action to perform on the component

note.title: Note
note.description: Optional note for the command execution

description.title: Description
description.description: New description; only used by the UPDATE_DESCRIPTION command

domains.title: Domains
domains.description: New domains; only used by the UPDATE_DOMAIN command

publishComponents.title: Publishcomponents
publishComponents.description: PUBLISH of a workflow only: also publish the draft components it runs, at any depth

unpublishParents.title: Unpublishparents
unpublishParents.description: UNPUBLISH only: also unpublish your own public workflows that run this version, at any depth

deprecationNote.title: Deprecationnote
deprecationNote.description: DEPRECATE only: why the version is deprecated, shown to everyone who sees or runs it

ComponentConfigDto.title: ComponentConfigDto
ComponentConfigDto.description:
The user's decision for one previewed step, keyed by WorkflowStepPreviewDto.step_id.

Exactly one branch: reuse_component_id binds the step to an existing catalogue
component, or name+domain create a new tool from that step's CWL.

ComponentImpactDto.title: ComponentImpactDto
ComponentImpactDto.description:
What unpublishing or deleting this exact version touches - read by both dialogs
before the action. Other users' private workflows and drafts are only counted, never
named; public workflows are visible to everyone, so they are named with their owner.

ComponentKind.title: ComponentKind
ComponentKind.description:
Which child of the composite a Component is - CWL's Process subclasses, narrowed to
the two this repository models. A Tool is a leaf (CommandLineTool / ExpressionTool),
a Workflow is a composite whose steps run other Components.

ComponentMatchDto.title: ComponentMatchDto
ComponentMatchDto.description: A palette candidate's best fit on the canvas.

ComponentStatus.title: ComponentStatus
ComponentStatus.description:
A component is staged privately until its creator publishes it. A published version
can later be deprecated: still readable, and everything already running it keeps
working, but it is no longer listed or offered for new use (see composite.lifecycle).

ComponentSummaryDto.title: ComponentSummaryDto
ComponentSummaryDto.description: The child a step runs - a tool, or a nested workflow.

ComponentUsageDto.title: ComponentUsageDto
ComponentUsageDto.description: A workflow version running some version(s) of a component - "Used in these workflows".

ConnectionDto.title: ConnectionDto
ConnectionDto.description: A builder edge: the output `sourcePort` of one component feeding the input `targetPort` of another.

ExistingComponentDto.title: ExistingComponentDto
ExistingComponentDto.description: The component currently holding a name, returned when that name is taken.

FormatLabelDto.title: FormatLabelDto
FormatLabelDto.description: A hand-written label for a File port without an ontology format, e.g. "RDS".

NameAvailabilityDto.title: NameAvailabilityDto
NameAvailabilityDto.description:
Whether a name can still be claimed for a new lineage - of either kind, since names
are one key across tools and workflows. Lets a caller warn (and offer to reuse the
existing component) while the user is typing, instead of only failing with a 409
after the whole upload has been submitted.

PackagePreviewDto.title: PackagePreviewDto
PackagePreviewDto.description: A GitHub repo packaged but not persisted (POST /tools/package/preview).

ParameterDto.title: ParameterDto
ParameterDto.description: One port of a component - a tool's input/output, or a workflow's own.

PreviewParameterDto.title: PreviewParameterDto
PreviewParameterDto.description:
A previewed port. Deliberately NOT ParameterDto: that carries a real uuid primary
key, and these are never persisted - the id here is a synthetic, stable-within-one-
response string that only exists to give the UI a list key.

StepComponentMatchDto.title: StepComponentMatchDto
StepComponentMatchDto.description: An existing component a step could bind to instead of creating a new one.

command.description: The specific action to perform on the tool

note.title: Note
note.description: Optional note for the command execution

formatLabels.title: Formatlabels
formatLabels.description: Hand-written labels for File ports without an ontology format; only used by the UPDATE_FORMAT_LABELS command

ToolPreviewDto.title: ToolPreviewDto
ToolPreviewDto.description:
Everything read out of a tool's CWL document without persisting it.

Shared by both upload flows: /tools/parse returns exactly this, and the workflow
upload's per-step WorkflowStepPreviewDto extends it with the step it came from.

WorkflowDraftWriteRequestDto.title: WorkflowDraftWriteRequestDto
WorkflowDraftWriteRequestDto.description: Body for both create and update - the editor always sends the full canvas.

command.description: The specific action to perform on the step

note.title: Note
note.description: Optional note for the command execution

WorkflowStepPreviewDto.title: WorkflowStepPreviewDto
WorkflowStepPreviewDto.description:
One workflow step rendered as the tool it would become, so the user can review and
configure it before the workflow is saved.
